resources.string: Channel difference map. Touch to inspect a pixel; activate to inspect the center.
DIFF MAP PRO · Red: R changed · Green: G changed · Blue: B changed. Combined changes mix colors; black means unchanged.
Touch and drag the map to inspect exact source RGB values and least significant bits. Activate to inspect the center pixel.
X-RAY · Encoded RGB least significant bits amplified to 0 or 255. No original image needed.

Diff previews combine changed channels within each display bin; the loupe magnifies those bins. RGB values and statistics use exact source pixels. X-ray previews sample the LSB plane; natural images also contain LSB noise.
Pixels changed: %1$d Image changed: %2$.4f%% Maximum channel change: %3$d/255 PSNR: %4$s

Same generated 320 × 320 cover, same 2,048-byte public demo payload and credentials, compression off. Each encryption uses fresh salt and IV, so ciphertext and change counts differ. Standard clusters changes; Ghost spreads them. Both have a visible header and use the same encryption.
Maps ready. Ghost changes placement, not encryption strength.
